Her approach is scientific, patient-centric, and highly effective.
Though she is disciplined and knows exactly what needs to be done, she is also incredibly warm, positive, and encouraging. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Shirin Hegdepatil to anyone seeking physiotherapy for orthopaedic conditions. Her incredible patience, clear advice, and easy‑to‑follow, step‑by‑step guidance made Zoom feel like no limitation whatsoever. Every session felt personal, supportive, and highly effective. Above all she is an excellent person, always smiling and patiently listening to our problems, flexible with her schedule to make it work for us. Her sessions were something we used to look forward to for her motivation and upliftment.
While recovery from a stroke can be long and painful, with Dr Charitha’s support we were able to perform basic duties within a month and challenge with tougher tasks within two months. We were absolutely thrilled with the experience and the results—we truly couldn’t have been happier! Truly a God send for us and highly highly recommend for anyone who is looking for a speedy recovery in a genuinely humane and compassionate  approach.
